protocol: Bounded larger SG SNAP fit after the initialization-only comparison
selection_evidence: All six paired-initialization circuits fail the state criterion. Their low/high training objectives agree closely, while some full-circuit tails worsen. This motivates a joint coverage and depth trial, without claiming that either cause has been isolated.
initialization: The same diagonal-plus-paired-frame PCG64 rule as the preceding comparison, at the new dimensions.
objective: The same common-phase action MSE formula, uniformly weighted on the first 32 columns, with regularization 1e-8 and unchanged phase/displacement bounds.
selection: Minimum training objective among all three starts, selected before full-circuit evaluation.
acceptance: Original SG thresholds and 96/128 validation. A boundary-only limitation can receive one same-parameter 128/160 refinement.
stopping_rule: Complete this three-start size comparison. Do not launch an unbounded size ladder. An unresolved result remains a bounded negative result, with initialization and size effects reported separately.
independent_evaluation: The second physical preparation and fixed trig circuits remain those declared before the preceding initialization comparison. They are not used in this training or selection.
